variant.author: MidoriKami
variant.changelog:
New Features!

Better Emote Window - Expands the emote list, and shows a preview of what various emotes will show in chat including name resolution.

Faux Hollows Helper - Helps indicate where to select in the Faux Hollows minigame, and indicates likely locations for the Faux Commander!

Additional Hotbars - You can now add as many hotbars with as many hotbar slots as you want!
NOTE: This feature is highly experimental, and will not support Hotkeys.

Show Active Signs - Adds a checkmark indicator to signs that are currently active to the Signs window.
